title: docs(adr): ADR-0157 working calendars are organization-editable runtime data, resolved by code or refused
body:
Fixes #35354
Clause-②: no (an ADR records a ruling; the enforcing changes are the three implementation cards)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读
- 用户能看到什么变化：用户无感；这是一份设计记录，把平台工作日历（工作日、节假日、调休）的七条裁决写成合同，后面三张实现卡照它做。
- 为什么做：来自「平台工作日历」专题；审批超时、服务时效和交期今天都按自然小时算，三个套件需要统一的工作日口径。
- 出错会怎样：只影响后续实现卡的依据，不改任何运行行为；写错了撤回或改这份记录即可。
- 要你做什么：审阅后合入；另有六个裁决没覆盖的细节问题（列在记录末尾），席位会单独请你定。

## 席位核对

### What changes
- New `docs/adr/0157-working-calendars-are-org-editable-runtime-data-resolved-by-code-or-refused.md`, Status **Proposed**. D1 to D7 record the seven items of ruling 7000950747 on #35340, one D-item per Scope item of #35354, in the ruling's own terms. It declares and implements nothing.
- Enforcement names #35355 (objects, calendar service, Setup page), #35356 (the three formula functions, pushdown refusal and lint) and #35357 (`escalation.clock` / `escalation.calendar`).
- Follow-up recorded, not changed: the gantt view's own `skipWeekends` / `holidays` (`ObjectGanttSchema` in `ui/packages/types/src/zod/objectql.zod.ts`) as a second source of truth.
- Six open questions the ruling does not answer, each with options and a recommendation, none picked by the record: Q1 past the maintained-through date warn or refuse; Q2 what a refusal does inside the approval sweep; Q3 exception and period shape (partial days, two exceptions on one date, a 24:00 end); Q4 daylight-saving days in `addWorkingHours`; Q5 working-time deadline fixed or recomputed; Q6 whether a package seed may overwrite an organization's edit.
- `docs/adr/README.md` regenerated by `pnpm adr:index` (generator-owned). Besides the new row and the counts, the regeneration also refreshes the ADR-0137 row, whose status line on `main` had moved without an index regeneration.

### Tests
No code. Gates derived by `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` for this diff, run at head `ba0ab5fd4`: 21 of 21 exit 0, reconciled by `--ran` (21 derived, 21 run, 0 NOT MEASURED, every line carrying its exit code).

<details><summary>Gate verdict lines</summary>

- `check-adr-links`: 1157 relative link destination(s) under docs/adr/ resolve
- `check:adr-symbol-anchors`: 3787 anchors across 159 records resolve, 0 line anchors
- `check:adr-index`: docs/adr/README.md is current, every record parsed
- `check:adr-anchors`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:pm-prior-rulings`, `check:pm-governed-merges`, `check:closed-ceremony-text` and the rest of the 21: exit 0
- `check:doc-formula-expressions` first exited 3 (prerequisite: `@objectstack/formula` and `@objectstack/lint` not built; nothing measured), then exit 0 after building those two under the verify lock.

</details>

### Acceptance notes
- A1: `docs/adr/` ended at 0156 on `origin/main` `3819afec`; none of the 46 open PRs touches `docs/adr/`, so 0157 is free.
- A2: the describe text and JSDoc on `timeoutHours` in `ApprovalEscalationSchema` still say the platform ships no business-hours calendar; D5 names that key.
- A3: recorded as a follow-up only.
- A4: ADR-0144 is the precedent for organization-scoped, admin-written, audited runtime data. It does not itself say packages seed rows; the seed contract is `seed.zod.ts`, which Q6 reads. ADR-0049 carries "inert"; the same-release constraint comes from the #13655 ruling record 5478756633 (the issue answers 404), not from ADR-0049.
- The release-pairing hold in D4 cites the ADR-0144 D9 precedent and says it is the epic PM's placement there, not that ruling's.

### Verification
Read the Decision section against ruling 7000950747: each D-item should restate one item and add nothing the ruling did not say; each "Not ruled, and listed" line should point to an open question.

Governed (Tier H): stays draft; landing is the maintainer's.
